parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
beforehand[bifɔ:rhænd]adv.
If something is done beforehand, then it is done in advance.
→ He packed his luggage beforehand, so he was able to leave right away.
😎
centigrade[sentəgreid]n.
If a temperature is centigrade, it is scaled, so water freezes at 0° and boils at 100°.
→ During the spring time, the temperature gets as warm as 26 degrees centigrade.
😎
chatter[tʃætər]v.
To chatter means to talk quickly about unimportant things.
→ The children chattered in the back of the classroom.
😎
concerto[kəntʃertou]n.
A concerto is music for a solo instrument and played with an orchestra.
→ The piano concerto has a section in which only the piano plays.
😎
condense[kəndens]v.
To condense a gas means to make it a liquid.
→ The cool air made tiny drops of water condense on the tops of the grass.
😎
cove[kouv]n.
A cove is a part of land where it curves inward around the sea.
→ They hid the boat in a small cove on the south side of the island.
😎
deteriorate[ditiəriəreit]v.
To deteriorate means to become steadily worse.
→ The nation's economy continued to deteriorate despite the politicians' efforts.
😎
exterior[ikstiəriər]n.
An exterior is the outside surface of something.
→ The exterior of the nut was hard and woody, but the inside was soft and delicious.
😎
freeway[fri:wei]n.
A freeway is a road with no stops where cars travel at high speeds.
→ Once you get on the freeway, it only takes an hour to drive to my parent's farm.
😎
hearty[hɑ:rti]adj.
If someone or something is hearty, then they are loud and happy.
→ The grandmother ended her story with a hearty laugh that pleased her grandchild.
😎
hospitable[hɑspitəbl]adj.
If someone is hospitable, they are friendly to strangers.
→ At dinner, Dad was very hospitable to my friends.
😎
manor[mænər]n.
A manor is a large house with many rooms.
→ The manor had over forty rooms in addition to beautiful gardens.
😎
monastery[mɑnəsteri]n.
A monastery is a building in which monks live.
→ The monks at this monastery are famous for their bread and music.
😎
nursery[nə:rsəri]n.
A nursery is a room where babies and children sleep, play, or are cared for.
→ The children kissed their parents goodnight and went upstairs to the nursery.
😎
outstretched[autstretʃt]adj.
If something is outstretched, then it is extended to its full length.
→ The cat stood on its back legs with its front legs outstretched.
😎
parcel[pɑ:rsəl]n.
A parcel is a package of things to be carried or mailed somewhere.
→ The parcel looked like it had been stepped on by someone.
😎
profile[proufail]n.
A profile is an outline of a face, usually as seen from the side.
→ The drawing of Olivia's profile came out very well.
😎
vivacious[viveiʃəs]adj.
If someone is vivacious, they are talkative and cheerful.
→ Everyone at the party was very vivacious and having a good time.
😎
winding[waindiŋ]adj.
If something is winding, then it follows a twisting course.
→ The winding river turned and looped around the bases of the hills.
😎
zip[zip]v.
To zip something means to close it with a zipper.
→ She zipped her backpack closed after putting her books inside it.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: 1. Who is someone that would most likely be hospitable?
questions.explanation: hospitable (adj): friendly to strangers. A host is someone who would most likely be hospitable.

questions.content: 2. At what temperature centigrade does water freeze?
questions.explanation: centigrade (n): a scale where water freezes at 0 degrees.

questions.content: 3. If the mist from fog condensed, what would happen to the ground?
questions.explanation: condense (v): to make a gas into a liquid. The ground would be wet.

questions.content: 4. If you are going on a trip, which is something you should do beforehand?
questions.explanation: beforehand (adv): in advance. You should pack clothes beforehand.

questions.content: 5. Who of the following would most likely perform a concerto?
questions.explanation: concerto (n): music for a solo instrument and orchestra. A musician would perform it.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content: 1. They didn't want to get covered with sand, so they relaxed on an extended blanket. [ 16 ]
questions.explanation: outstretched means extended.

questions.content: 2. The boys were talking quickly about what they were going to do that weekend. [ 17 ]
questions.explanation: chattering means talking quickly.

questions.content: 3. It's easy to go past the exit when you're driving on the road where cars drive fast. [ 18 ]
questions.explanation: freeway is a road where cars drive fast.

questions.content: 4. This building used to be a house where monks lived, but now it's used as a museum. [ 19 ]
questions.explanation: monastery is a building where monks live.

questions.content: 5. The twisting path that went through the mountains was beautiful to hike in the spring. [ 20 ]
questions.explanation: winding means twisting.

questions.content: 6. The photograph showed *one side of the man's face*. [ 21 ]
questions.explanation: profile means an outline of a face, usually from the side.

questions.content: 7. Their chances of escaping the room became worse as the water level continued to rise. [ 22 ]
questions.explanation: deteriorated means became worse.

questions.content: 8. The outside surface of the car looked bad, but the inside still looked new. [ 23 ]
questions.explanation: exterior is the outside surface.

questions.content: 9. Lisa is a very loud and happy person. [ 24 ]
questions.explanation: hearty means loud and happy.

questions.content: 10. I'll remember her forever. I had never before met such a *cheerful, talkative* person. [ 25 ]
questions.explanation: vivacious means talkative and cheerful.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Nurse's Lesson

One of the children in the nursery was sick. The child's mother, who was usually quite vivacious and chattered constantly, was quiet and worried. She knew that if she did not act quickly, the child's condition would deteriorate.

She summoned the children's nurse and said to her, “The monks make a medicine that can cure my child’s sickness. Please, hurry tonight to the monastery and get it.”

The nurse immediately hurried from the manor to get the medicine. The monastery was far away by Rabbit Cove, and there was no freeway leading to it. The only way there was to walk along a dark and winding trail.

The temperature was close to zero degrees centigrade, and it was raining. Luckily, the nurse had grabbed her raincoat beforehand. She zipped it up and pulled the hood over her head.

“I’ll never make it there,” she thought. “Perhaps I should return and go in the morning.” But she remembered the sick child and decided to continue.

Finally, she arrived at the monastery. It was very late. She feared the monks would not be hospitable. But she approached the door and knocked anyway. The rain had condensed on the exterior of the windows by the door. All she could see was the profile of a large man coming to answer the door. Again, she was filled with fear.

But the monk smiled at her when he opened the door. He took her outstretched hand and welcomed her with a hearty voice. The place was warm, and she heard a concerto playing in another room. She relaxed.

“How can I help you?” the monk asked, and the nurse explained the situation.

He instantly knew what to do. He grabbed a parcel of medicine and took her back to the manor in a carriage. The medicine worked. The nurse was happy she had persevered through the bad weather and found the monastery. Now the boy would be able to live a long natural life.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false.

questions.content: 1. The nurse was usually a vivacious woman who constantly chattered.
questions.explanation:
Dịch: Người y tá thường là một người phụ nữ hoạt bát và luôn miệng trò chuyện.
Giải thích: F. Đoạn 1 viết: "The child's mother, who was usually quite vivacious and chattered constantly..." (Mẹ của đứa trẻ, người thường khá hoạt bát và luôn miệng trò chuyện...). Do đó, người hoạt bát và hay nói chuyện là mẹ của đứa trẻ, không phải người y tá.

questions.content: 2. The nursery was far from the freeway that was near Rabbit Cove.
questions.explanation:
Dịch: Phòng trẻ em cách xa đường cao tốc gần Vịnh Thỏ.
Giải thích: F. Đoạn 3 có viết: "The monastery was far away by Rabbit Cove, and there was no freeway leading to it." (Tu viện ở rất xa cạnh Vịnh Thỏ, và không có đường cao tốc nào dẫn đến đó). Thứ ở Vịnh Thỏ là tu viện (monastery) và không hề có đường cao tốc (no freeway) nào. Câu này sai hoàn toàn.

questions.content: 3. When it started to deteriorate, the nurse zipped up the jacket she had brought beforehand.
questions.explanation:
Dịch: Khi thời tiết bắt đầu xấu đi, người y tá kéo khóa chiếc áo khoác mà cô đã mang theo từ trước.
Giải thích: F. Đoạn 1 từ "deteriorate" được dùng để nói về tình trạng của đứa trẻ: "the child's condition would deteriorate" (tình trạng của đứa trẻ sẽ trở nên tồi tệ hơn). Câu hỏi cố tình dùng sai ngữ cảnh của từ này.

questions.content: 4. The temperature was close to zero degrees centigrade.
questions.explanation:
Dịch: Nhiệt độ gần bằng 0 độ C.
Giải thích: T. Đoạn 4 nêu rõ: "The temperature was close to zero degrees centigrade" (Nhiệt độ gần bằng 0 độ C). Câu này hoàn toàn chính xác.

questions.content: 5. When the nurse heard a concerto playing in another room, she became hospitable.
questions.explanation:
Dịch: Khi người y tá nghe thấy một bản hòa tấu đang được chơi ở phòng khác, cô ấy trở nên hiếu khách.
Giải thích: F. Đoạn 7 viết: "she heard a concerto playing in another room. She relaxed." (cô ấy nghe thấy một bản hòa tấu đang chơi ở phòng khác. Cô ấy cảm thấy thư giãn). Cô ấy thư giãn (relaxed) chứ không phải trở nên hiếu khách (hospitable).

questions.content: 1. Where did the dark and winding trail lead?
options: The dark and winding trail went to the monastery.
questions.explanation:
Dịch câu hỏi: Con đường tối tăm và ngoằn ngoèo dẫn đến đâu?
Giải thích: Chọn A.
Đoạn 3 có viết: "The monastery was far away... The only way there was to walk along a dark and winding trail." (Tu viện ở rất xa... Cách duy nhất đến đó là đi dọc theo một con đường mòn tối tăm và ngoằn ngoèo). Vậy con đường đó dẫn đến tu viện (monastery).

questions.content: 2. Who took the nurse's outstretched hand and welcomed her with a hearty voice?
options: The monk took the nurse's outstretched hand and welcomed her with a hearty voice.
questions.explanation:
Dịch câu hỏi: Ai đã nắm lấy bàn tay đang dang ra của người y tá và chào đón cô bằng một giọng điệu nồng nhiệt?
Giải thích: Chọn A.
Đoạn 7 có viết: "But the monk smiled at her when he opened the door. He took her outstretched hand and welcomed her with a hearty voice." (Nhưng nhà sư đã mỉm cười với cô ấy khi ông mở cửa. Ông nắm lấy bàn tay đang dang ra của cô và chào đón cô bằng một giọng điệu nồng nhiệt). Đó chính là nhà sư (the monk).

questions.content: 3. How did the nurse feel when she saw the profile of a man coming to answer the door?
options: When she saw the profile of a man coming to answer the door, the nurse was filled with fear.
questions.explanation:
Dịch câu hỏi: Người y tá cảm thấy thế nào khi nhìn thấy dáng người của một người đàn ông ra mở cửa?
Giải thích: Chọn A.
Đoạn 6 mô tả: "All she could see was the profile of a large man coming to answer the door. Again, she was filled with fear." (Tất cả những gì cô có thể nhìn thấy là bóng dáng của một người đàn ông to lớn đang tiến ra mở cửa. Một lần nữa, cô lại tràn ngập nỗi sợ hãi). Cô ấy đã cảm thấy sợ hãi (filled with fear).

questions.content: 4. What had condensed on the exterior of the monastery's windows?
options: Rain had condensed on the exterior of the monastery's windows.
questions.explanation:
Dịch câu hỏi: Thứ gì đã đọng lại trên mặt ngoài của cửa sổ tu viện?
Giải thích: Chọn A.
Đoạn 6 viết: "The rain had condensed on the exterior of the windows by the door." (Mưa đã đọng lại trên mặt ngoài của những chiếc cửa sổ cạnh cửa ra vào). Vậy nên đáp án đúng là mưa (rain).

questions.content: 5. What was in the parcel that the nurse took back to the manor?
options: Medicine was in the parcel that the nurse took back to the manor.
questions.explanation:
Dịch câu hỏi: Có gì trong gói đồ mà người y tá mang về dinh thự?
Giải thích: Chọn A.
Đoạn 9 viết: "He grabbed a parcel of medicine and took her back to the manor in a carriage." (Ông ấy lấy một gói thuốc và đưa cô quay lại dinh thự bằng xe ngựa). Bên trong gói đồ là thuốc (medicine).
